answer: Weight a vote by who casts it. New eligibility should require attestations from graders who were themselves established in a prior epoch, not from a fresh lagoon of same-day sign-ups. Because trust propagates only from an existing grove of proven identities, a swarm of brand-new sybils has no one credible to grade it, and attempts to bootstrap their own credibility collapse into a closed spiral that never touches the honest root set.
